entries.title: Cultist Simulator
entries.definitive_edition: Cultist Simulator: Anthology Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC Anthology Edition is the best archive route because it keeps the original PC interface/capture path and includes the base game plus the Dancer, Priest, Ghoul, Exile, and soundtrack content; later console and mobile versions do not have platform-exclusive story content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Cultist Simulator: Anthology Edition on Steam or GOG for Windows PC to get the base game, all major DLC, and the soundtrack.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with Anthology Edition bundle including all major DLC and soundtrack.
all_releases.reason: primary: original interface/capture route and complete DLC bundle.

entries.title: BOOK OF HOURS
entries.definitive_edition: BOOK OF HOURS on Windows PC with HOUSE OF LIGHT DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with HOUSE OF LIGHT DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because BOOK OF HOURS is sourced as a PC/Mac/Linux release, the House of Light expansion is available on the same PC storefront path, and no console or mobile release with exclusive content is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy BOOK OF HOURS on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and add the HOUSE OF LIGHT DLC for the current complete story/expansion route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with House of Light expansion available.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete current route with best capture/input flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows PC route has the House of Light expansion and no exclusive content is documented on Mac or Linux.

entries.remaster_caveats: HOUSE OF LIGHT is expansion DLC, not a separate game entry. The Lady Afterwards is a tabletop RPG in the same IP, so it is not tracked as a video-game entry here.
